title: tgrad: cyclic monitoring of financial transaction streams (code, benchmark generator and results)
description: Code, synthetic benchmark generator and per-seed results for the paper "A Nodal Probability Distribution Model with Distribution-Governed Cyclic Monitoring for Financial Transaction Streams". The repository contains the benchmark generator, the event-driven encoder and energy head, one script for each table and figure in the paper, and the outputs behind every reported number. The Elliptic dataset is not redistributed.
